content_text: Hello Roger, I am researching the importance of having a good relationship as a DOP with your director for an essay for my film degree and wanted to ask you a question about your experiences. Could you talk a little about what it is like to work with so many different directors and understanding their differing visions, and as a cinematographer, would you prefer to work with the same people over and over again or with someone new?
